diagnosis.directLibreOffice: The same reference document reaches a 15-second timeout when LibreOffice runs directly with a fresh profile, outside Gotenberg.
diagnosis.interpretation: Evidence points to a layout interaction between headers/footers and repeated image tables. The exact upstream layout defect is not established. The original corpus files were preserved.
diagnosis.propagation: Gotenberg normally recycles LibreOffice after ten attempts. Its health check tests socket connectivity; a stalled layout process can still accept sockets. Restart-after=1 recycles after timed-out attempts as well.
diagnosis.tradeoff: Every conversion pays process-recycling overhead; no automatic retry of a failed document.

ci: Docker production smoke and timeout/recovery job configured; remote result tracked in GitHub Actions
